why: Artifacts pin the inputs they were computed from. A few historical inputs were already unrecoverable when this repository was consolidated. Each exception is matched on the exact original path and missing expected digest. Recoverable versions belong in provenance/frozen-code and remain byte-verified; a new missing digest or any corrupted archived blob fails the gate.
how_to_add: Do not add an entry to make a failing gate pass. An entry is only correct when the pinned bytes are genuinely unrecoverable AND the artifact that pinned them is frozen. If the input still exists somewhere, restore it instead.

known_drift.reason: The phase-1 split manifest was regenerated upstream after the prelaunch audit ran. The audit's own conclusions are frozen and the superseded manifest was never committed, so the pinned bytes are unrecoverable. Inherited from forge; unchanged across every commit in this repository.
A code pin: the preflight artifact records the hash of a launcher revision whose bytes were already unavailable when this repository was consolidated.
A second preflight artifact pins another launcher revision whose bytes were already unavailable when this repository was consolidated.
